points: Designed modular web modules with ASP.NET Core, Web API, EF Core and SQL Server, following SOLID principles and clean architecture.
Built responsive React interfaces with Hooks, integrated with ASP.NET Web APIs.
Led Prod and UAT migrations for 2,000+ users with zero post-delivery defects, and executed an Oracle 19c upgrade that sped up database queries by 20%.
Implemented single sign-on with Ping Federate (SAML), SSL certificates and DNS configuration across environments.
Wrote SQL failover scripts that raised operational readiness by 30%, and resolved P1 and P2 incidents while holding 100% SLA compliance.
Wrote migration runbooks that cut onboarding effort by 40%, and championed GitHub Copilot and AI-assisted workflows.
Built core application features with ASP.NET MVC, React, SQL Server, HTML5, CSS3 and JavaScript.
Worked with senior engineers and QA in Agile sprints to fix UI defects and optimize REST APIs.
Implemented responsive client-side data binding and secure API endpoints.
